m: सं-छादनी f. ‘that which covers’, the skin, L.
सं-√ 1. छद् Caus. -छादयति, to cover over, envelop, conceal, hide, obscure, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.; to put on (as a garment), Vop.
सं-√ 2. छद् (or छन्द्), Caus. -छन्दयति (only ind.p. -छन्द्य), to present, offer (with acc. of pers. and instr. of thing), MBh.
a: संछद् — {c10c} U. 1 To hide, conceal. --2 To envelope, cover, wrap up. --3 To put on (as clothes).

m: सं-छन्न mfn. entirely covered or enveloped or clothed, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
a: संछन्न — p. p. 1 Enveloped, concealed, hidden. --2 Clothed. --3 Surrounded.

m: सं-छर्दन n. spitting out, vomiting forth, ejecting (one of the ten ways in which an eclipse is supposed to end, cf. राहु-ग्रसन), VarBṛS.
सं-छेद्य n. ‘the flowing together of two rivers’ or ‘the mouth of a river entering the sea’, L.
सं-छेत्तव्य mfn. to be cut through or removed or resolved (as a doubt), MBh.
सं-˚छेत्तृ mfn. one who removes or resolves (a doubt), ib.

सं-√ छिद् P. Ā. -छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, to cut to pieces, cut through, pierce, split, destroy, AV. &c. &c. ; to remove, resolve (a doubt), Bhag.; to decide, settle (a question), BhP. : Pass. -छिद्यते, to be cut to pieces &c., MBh.
a: संछिद् — {c7c} U. 1 To cut, cut off, divide. --2 To penetrate, pierce. --3 To remove, clear, solve, (as a doubt &c.). --4 To settle, decide (a question).

m: सं-छिन्न mfn. cut to pieces, cut off &c., MBh.
